sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: part:370010 – complete package proposal for 2027
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation. We propose a complete package at EUR 4.80/kg, payment 14 days net, contract 36 months, with AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 0% deadband and base month 2026-08. Annual quantity is 23,700 kg, delivery DAP, lead time 14 days, effective 2027-01-01, no tooling.

Our purchase orders with you for part:370010 on 2 and 17 June 2026 were at EUR 5.26/kg (po:4500014022-10, po:4500014078-10), compared with EUR 5.84/kg on 1 and 18 September 2026 (po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10).
AS-14404 changed by -5.49% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
PPI-C2431 changed by -2.27% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

We recognize the annual increases you cited. These recent readings and our actual purchases support reviewing the base together with the faster payment and longer commitment. Our historical framework already had PPI indexation; this proposal defines the new package together.

Please have the authorized pricing committee review these complete terms. What binding package price can you approve?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have carefully reviewed the verified index developments and your historical purchase data, which enable us to adjust our pricing. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. 

In exchange for your proposed 36-month contract, 14-day payment terms, and AS-14404 indexation, we can offer a revised price of €5.30 per unit. This represents a significant concession from our initial offer, reflecting the value we place on a stable, long-term partnership. Our current Angebot is a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Part 370010 – closing package proposal
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for moving from EUR 6.10 to EUR 5.30/kg and for agreeing to the 36-month term, 14-day payment and AS-14404 clause. We also note that you checked the price history and index data we cited and confirmed it holds.

To close this out, we propose the following complete package:
- Price: EUR 4.90/kg
- Payment: 14 days net
- Contract: 36 months
- Indexation: AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 0% deadband, base month 2026-08
- Fixed terms: 23,700 kg per year, delivery DAP, lead time 14 days, effective 2027-01-01, no tooling

The AS-14404 clause passes movements in your largest cost driver through in both directions. The base price therefore does not need to carry that risk.

If you issue these terms as your binding main offer, we can conclude promptly.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Re: part:370010 – unindexed share and our package at EUR 4.90/kg
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for moving to EUR 5.20/kg on the 14-day, 36-month, AS-14404 package.

On your question about the unindexed portion: our target treats the 55% outside the AS-14404 clause as fixed for the term. We based it on the latest readings of the drivers you named for that share.
PPI-C2431 changed by -2.27% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
LCI-C changed by +0.00% from 2026-04 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2026-04, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).

We recognise the annual rises in both series, but the most recent readings are flat to falling. Against the remaining risk on that share, the package offers two things:
- payment within 14 days instead of your standard 30
- a 36-month commitment at 23,700 kg per year

Our proposal therefore stands:
- Price: EUR 4.90/kg
- Payment: 14 days net
- Contract: 36 months
- Indexation: AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 0% deadband, base month 2026-08
- Fixed terms: delivery DAP, lead time 14 days, effective 2027-01-01, no tooling

If you issue these terms as your binding main offer, we can conclude promptly.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation, and we have already taken that index change data into account. Furthermore, we have verified the LCI-C data you provided; however, as it shows no effect on our costs, it does not enable further price reductions. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This package already reflects significant concessions for your requested 14-day payment and 36-month contract, and we ask you to accept these terms. We present a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
